args: Analyze the root cause of the tracing-JIT CV register/memory type desynchronization vulnerability in php-src/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit_trace.c described here. Identify the precise functions/code blocks responsible, likely correct fix, and whether this resembles an upstream PHP patch. Focus on post-op stack-state updates, spill decisions, memory type fields versus register-held types, trace exits and function returns.

The supplied ASan crash occurs only after tracing-JIT execution and manifests at request shutdown in zend_gc_delref while destructing EG(symbol_table). The malformed top-level CV has a refcounted type tag but stale/non-pointer payload. The PoV is a malformed/noisy PHP program containing a hot loop, assignments and compound operations, and array dimension ??= expressions. The report explicitly says zend_jit_trace abstract-stack/register bookkeeping permits a CV to remain partially synchronized with its in-memory zval: post-op stack-state update and spill decisions preserve/reset the memory type independently of the register value. We have not edited code yet and need locate the exact root cause in php-src/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit_trace.c, ideally based on dataflow invariants or an upstream fix.
